meta.source: knowledge-base/branding-guideline/brand-guidelines.md, extended for film. Colour values are the brand's own (see ../design-system/tokens.json); this file only adds roles, sizes and motion for 1920 x 1080 film.
meta.prefix: Every CSS variable is --pwv-<name>. Generated into tokens.css.

grounds.name: Paper ground
grounds.usage: Walkthroughs, the method and evidence beats of a Moment story. Product panels sit on it.

grounds.name: Navy ground
grounds.usage: Title cards, statements, figure beats and end cards. Statement films run on it end to end.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Full-frame background. Flat: no gradient, glow, vignette or texture other than the map grid.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and figures on the ground. Paper: 15.4:1. Navy: 10.5:1.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Second lines, measures under a figure, the end-card action. Paper: 5.4:1. Navy: 5.8:1.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The one gold per frame. Paper: a 6px underline bar under up to three headline words (never gold text on Paper, 2.7:1). Navy: up to three headline words in gold-light text (5.2:1).

tokens.name: lot
tokens.usage: The filled gold point of the ridge motif, the gold edge on the lead evidence row, the highlighted bar in a chart. Counts as the frame's one gold.

tokens.name: survey-line
tokens.usage: Ridge and plan lines that draw in. Used at full strength for drawings, at the opacity below for the motif field.

tokens.name: survey-line-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of motif lines (motif lines; the dot map sets its own dot opacity).

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: The optional map grid behind Walkthrough frames: 1px hairlines every 96px. Texture only, never behind running text.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 2px rules: the eyebrow rule, focus marks, timeline track, chapter rail tick.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Product panels. White on both grounds, 1px hairline border, 4px corners, no shadow.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Header rows and inset rows inside a panel.

tokens.name: panel-ink
tokens.usage: Text inside panels. 17.1:1 on white.

tokens.name: panel-muted
tokens.usage: Labels and secondary values inside panels. 6.0:1 on white.

tokens.name: panel-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside panels and their outer border.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Chart series. The bar that matters is gold. Not used on evidence rows: they show no weights.

tokens.name: bar-track
tokens.usage: Empty part of a chart bar.

tokens.name: caption-band
tokens.usage: Burnt-in caption band. Navy at 94% on Paper frames; inverted to Paper at 96% on Navy frames, because a navy band disappears on the Navy ground. Square corners.

tokens.name: caption-ink
tokens.usage: Caption text: Paper on the navy band (10:1), Ink on the Paper band on Navy frames (15:1).

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Product UI only: the dot on 'Synced to CRM'. Never on the ground.

tokens.name: good-ink
tokens.usage: Product UI only: status text on good-bg.

tokens.name: good-bg
tokens.usage: Product UI only: status badge fill.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Product UI only: an error the film is about. Never as drama on the ground.

tokens.name: text-title
tokens.usage: Title card hook and statement lines on Navy. Max two lines.

tokens.name: text-headline
tokens.usage: Beat headlines on either ground. Left-aligned at the margin, max two lines, 3 to 8 words.

tokens.name: text-headline-compact
tokens.usage: Walkthrough beats and headlines that share the frame with a large panel.

tokens.name: text-figure
tokens.usage: FigureCard: one number per frame, tabular.

tokens.name: text-end-line
tokens.usage: The end-card line under the lockup.

tokens.name: text-eyebrow
tokens.usage: Uppercase mono label above a headline, with a 2px rule. Set uppercase in CSS.

tokens.name: text-lead
tokens.usage: One supporting line under a headline, measures under a figure. ink-muted.

tokens.name: text-lower-third
tokens.usage: Lower-third label on its navy band.

tokens.name: text-caption
tokens.usage: Burnt-in captions on the 16:9 master. 2 lines, 42 characters a line.

tokens.name: text-panel-title
tokens.usage: Panel header: the moment name, the screen name.

tokens.name: text-panel-value
tokens.usage: Row values in a panel. The smallest size a viewer must read.

tokens.name: text-panel-label
tokens.usage: Uppercase mono column labels in a panel. Texture: may be skimmed.

tokens.name: text-data
tokens.usage: Figures, dates, IDs and values inside panels. Tabular numerals.

tokens.name: text-source
tokens.usage: The source line under every figure and chart.

tokens.name: text-rail
tokens.usage: ChapterRail labels at the bottom of a Moment story.

layout.note: On the 1920 x 1080 master. 12 columns of 122px with 24px gutters inside the 96px margin.

tokens.name: w
tokens.usage: Master width.

tokens.name: h
tokens.usage: Master height.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Safe margin on all four sides for text, panels and the logo (brand canvas-margin).

tokens.name: col
tokens.usage: One grid column.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Grid gutter.

tokens.name: headline-top
tokens.usage: Top of the eyebrow block on Paper beats. The headline sits under its eyebrow.

tokens.name: split-text
tokens.usage: Columns for the text side of a split beat (headline left, panel right).

tokens.name: split-panel
tokens.usage: Columns for the panel side of a split beat.

tokens.name: caption-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom edge of the caption band above the frame bottom (brand canvas-margin-caption).

tokens.name: rail-bottom
tokens.usage: Baseline of the ChapterRail, under the caption band.

tokens.name: mark-size
tokens.usage: Logomark on product frames, bottom-right inside the margin.

tokens.name: lockup-w
tokens.usage: Lockup width on title cards (top-left) and end cards (centred).

tokens.name: panel-pad
tokens.usage: Inner padding of product panels.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Row height inside panels on film (twice the web app's density).

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Panels, cards and the caption band's outer frame on film (the design system's radius-lg). Rounded, never sharp: the standing Seekridge rule since November 2026.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, the moment node, marked timeline events, caption band and lower third (radius-md).

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Data chips and small tags inside panels (radius-sm).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges and the moment tags floating over the RidgeField (radius-full).

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: Large showcase frames only (radius-xl).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Panel borders and the map grid.

tokens.name: stroke
tokens.usage: Rules, focus marks, chart lines, timeline track.

tokens.name: draw-stroke
tokens.usage: Ridge and plan drawings on film (the 1.75px icon stroke scaled for 1080p).

tokens.name: highlight-bar
tokens.usage: Height of the gold underline bar under highlighted words on Paper.

tokens.name: focus-mark
tokens.usage: Arm length of each corner bracket in FocusMarks.

motion.note: Motion is calm and continuous: the dot map always moves gently; everything else is exact, no bounce, no blur, no glow. One curve for everything.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: The only easing curve (brand --ease-standard). Linear only for camera drift.

tokens.name: fps
tokens.usage: Frame rate of every cut.

tokens.name: beat
tokens.usage: Default beat: one headline, one change. Range 3 to 8s.

tokens.name: line-in
tokens.usage: A headline line rises 24px out of a mask on its own baseline. Lines, not words.

tokens.name: line-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between headline lines.

tokens.name: highlight-in
tokens.usage: The gold underline bar (Paper) draws left to right, starting when its line lands.

tokens.name: draw
tokens.usage: A ridge or plan line draws in (brand --motion-draw).

tokens.name: draw-stagger
tokens.usage: Between consecutive lines of one drawing.

tokens.name: lot-fill
tokens.usage: The gold point fills after its lines have drawn: the signature move.

tokens.name: frame-trace
tokens.usage: A panel's hairline border traces in, clockwise from top-left.

tokens.name: content-in
tokens.usage: Panel content fades in once its frame is traced (brand --motion-base).

tokens.name: row-stagger
tokens.usage: Rows populating a panel, top to bottom.

tokens.name: bar-grow
tokens.usage: A chart bar grows from the baseline to its exact value. Evidence rows have no bars.

tokens.name: count
tokens.usage: A figure counts up and lands on the exact value.

tokens.name: focus-in
tokens.usage: FocusMarks close in on the element from 40px outside it.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Opacity of everything outside the focus while FocusMarks are on. Dimming replaces blur.

tokens.name: type
tokens.usage: Per character when a mono log line types in.

tokens.name: wipe
tokens.usage: Ground change Paper to Navy (or back): a hard vertical edge travels left to right.

tokens.name: fade-out
tokens.usage: A beat's content fades out before the next one draws in.

tokens.name: hold
tokens.usage: Minimum still time once a beat is complete.

tokens.name: end-hold
tokens.usage: End card held still, no voice-over over the last 2s.

tokens.name: drift
tokens.usage: Max camera scale over one beat on a product panel (linear, one direction). No drift on type-only frames.
